protocol.cpu_affinity: one logical CPU, minimum inherited allowed CPU, recorded before timing

primary.metric: external wait4 user+system CPU seconds per whole fresh engine process
primary.secondary_metric: external monotonic wall seconds per whole fresh engine process

kernel.role: separate diagnostic, never a whole-engine/NPS/Elo claim
kernel.metric: driver clock CPU seconds for public out-of-line update loop
kernel.secondary_metric: driver steady-clock wall seconds for update loop

calibration.primary_failure_action: stop entire experiment before any A/B; preserve failure; no retries
calibration.kernel_failure_action: no kernel A/B; primary remains independently assessable

analysis.block_ratio: sum baseline seconds / sum candidate seconds within block
analysis.summary: geometric mean of six block ratios; interval assumes independent approximately normal block log ratios
analysis.assumptions: six finite completed counterbalanced blocks; independent block log ratios approximately normal; a finite pilot interval, not a sequential test or guarantee
analysis.permitted_claim: observed >=3% CPU speedup with 95% CI excluding no gain under this hosted suite
analysis.otherwise: inconclusive or descriptive; no acceptance claim

protocol.retention: all commands, raw stdout/stderr, return status, resource readouts, source exports, drivers, actual core/executable bytes, correctness logs, hashes before and after (finally), failure evidence; upload and unique results branch even on failure
protocol.trigger: push only forge/hosted-nnue-performance-20261019-*, run_attempt 1 only; ready status required before builds/timing
